title: temporal-gateway config.yml
description: The gateway config, loaded and validated by config.Load (internal/config). Any value may use ${VAR} / ${VAR:-default}, expanded on the raw bytes before YAML parsing (ADR-011); so every non-string field here also accepts such a reference. Unknown keys are ignored by the gateway; this schema rejects them to catch typos.

host.description: Listen address. Empty listens on every interface.

maxBodyBytes.description: Largest accepted request body, in bytes; a larger one gets 413. 0 or unset means 1 MiB.

requestTimeout.description: How long one request may spend dispatching to Temporal before it gets 504. Must be positive. The server's write timeout is this plus 5s.

connections.description: One entry per Temporal namespace the gateway dials. Namespaces must be unique (checked by config.Load; JSON Schema can't express it). Every x-temporal trigger names one of these (ADR-003).

reconnect.description: Retry policy for the startup dial (ADR-018, ADR-026). --dry-run always makes a single attempt.

interval.description: Wait between attempts. Must be positive.

maxAttempts.description: Attempts per namespace before the gateway exits. 0 retries forever.

apiSpec.description: Path(s) to the OpenAPI spec, relative to this file's directory unless absolute. Several files are merged in order (ADR-012, ADR-030).

auth.description: Parsed and logged only; NOT enforced against requests (ADR-015).

middlewares.description: Parsed and logged only; no middleware is applied (ADR-015).

otel.description: OpenTelemetry tracing, exported via OTLP/gRPC. Export is non-blocking: an unreachable collector never stops the gateway (ADR-013).

sampleRatio.description: Fraction of traces sampled, 0-1. A value <= 0 samples everything.

health.description: GET /livez and /readyz on their own port (ADR-019).

port.description: Required (1-65535) when enabled, and must differ from server.port (checked by config.Load; JSON Schema can't compare the two).

apiKey.description: API key credentials (e.g. Temporal Cloud); implies TLS. Set it from ${VAR}, never inline. Never logged.

certPath.description: mTLS client certificate. Set together with keyPath.

keyPath.description: mTLS client key. Set together with certPath.

caPath.description: PEM bundle replacing the system roots.

serverName.description: Overrides the name the server certificate is verified against.

workflows.description: This namespace's workflow catalog. taskQueue is the default for a startWorkflow trigger that sets none (ADR-031); signals and queries are informational, logged at startup only.

positiveDuration.description: A positive Go duration string (time.ParseDuration), e.g. "5s", "2m", or a ${VAR} reference.

envRef.description: A ${VAR} or ${VAR:-default} reference, expanded before parsing.
